top_signals.title: Stocks Fall as High Yields Pressure Valuations: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Stocks fell as bond yields hovering at two-decade highs pressured valuations and rebounding oil added to the case for interest rates staying higher for longer.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Treasury Yield Surge Pushes Spreads Versus Asia Near Extremes
top_signals.summary: The surge in Treasury yields has pushed yield gaps with emerging Asia bonds toward record levels, raising the risk of capital outflows from the region, according to strategists.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: SNB Holds Rates, Eases Threat of Franc Intervention
top_signals.summary: The Swiss National Bank dialed down its threat of intervention to weaken the franc and raised inflation forecasts while keeping interest rates unchanged. Bloomberg's Guy Johnson has the details. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

alerts.title: Canadian Man Pleads Guilty in Snowflake Extortions
alerts.summary: A 26-year-old Canadian man once described as one of the most consequential cybercrime threat actors of 2024 has pleaded guilty to computer fraud and conspiracy to hack and extort more than 165 organizations that used the cloud data storage provider Snowflake. Connor Riley Moucka, of Kitchener, Ontario, also admitted to stealing call and text history records of more than 100 million AT&T customers.

alerts.title: FBI investigating alleged ShinyHunters breach of its jobs site
alerts.summary: The ShinyHunters cybercriminal organization on Tuesday replaced agency images on the FBIjobs.gov site with a photo of a Pokemon that has become the group’s defacto mascot.
